name: Járdánháza (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Járdánháza (a blue and green shield with a red-clad figure holding a sabre, with a helm and red, blue and yellow mantling) above the name JÁRDÁNHÁZA in grey.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Járdánháza arms with helm and mantling
